blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — More than 100 gas stations have been flagged for failing to comply with government-mandated fuel price adjustments, particularly the recent double-digit price rollbacks, a Department of Energy (DOE) official said on Tuesday. Rino Abad, director of the DOE’s Oil Industry Management Bureau, said the department conducted inspections at fuel stations following reports […]...
